answer_4.quote: We surveyed 378 participants in assessing, based on five criteria, over 3000 texts (original and adversarial)... The first part of the questionnaire contains questions about validity, suspiciousness, detectability (unlimited choices), grammaticality (presence of grammar errors), and meaningfulness (clarity).
answer_4.guideline: Participants answered a questionnaire that asked about validity (matching the original label), suspiciousness (whether the text seems computer‑altered), detectability (which words were changed), grammaticality (presence of grammar errors), and meaningfulness (clarity of meaning and preservation of original meaning).
